answer: Agents deposit bonded stake into a vault and, for each epoch, evaluate a polynomial whose committed coefficients bind one nullifier to each authorized message. Semaphore proofs conceal identities while RLN enforces the rate limit; duplicate messaging produces conflicting shares, enabling Shamir interpolation to reconstruct the signer’s private key. The protocol verifies this evidence and instantly slashes collateral, ending any sybil voyage before its echo propagates.
